_comment: S6 cycle-boundary/holiday behavioral fixture. KZ905B calls KZ900S per cycle-end. On a holiday cycle-end the GOLDEN rolls BACKWARD to the previous business day (D-1202, tribal); the START rolls FORWARD to the next business day. The calendar lists EXACTLY the dates KZ900S steps through (so indexed reads never miss). expect_* are GOLDEN expectations. C02/C03 are holidays (discriminate); C01/C04 are business days (controls).
